summary: Stopped under hard stop 1: required documentation paths are outside the fixed exhaustive ownership list. No adapters, contracts, or tests implemented. Only the expressly mandated halt and finish records were written. Local commits only; no live services contacted. Build, format, fast tests, and replay not run. The head identifies the halt-record commit immediately preceding this finish-record commit.

deviations.why: These specific instructions require recording a hard stop. They do not authorize the other report and log paths required for implementation.

findings: The fixed ownership list excludes every required session documentation path; the task explicitly mandates hard stop 1 when an outside-owned-path change would be needed.

needs_human.item: Correct the conductor's ownership policy and gate for required session documentation.
